title: Adult with an acute panic episode
opening: I feel like I can't breathe, and my heart is pounding. I think something is really wrong with me.
goal: You are the clinician. Assess the episode, rule out cardiac red flags, and help the patient feel safe.

disclosures.response: It started about an hour ago, out of nowhere, while I was sitting at my desk.
My heart is racing so hard I thought I might pass out.
I can't catch my breath. It feels like I'm suffocating.
I'm terrified this is a heart attack and I'm going to die.
I did have three energy drinks this morning... I was cramming for an exam all night.
This has happened twice before, and both times it went away on its own.

metrics.name: Onset and context
metrics.rationale: Explores when the episode began and what was happening at the time.
metrics.coaching_hint: Ask when it started and what was happening just before.

metrics.name: Cardiac red flags
metrics.rationale: Rules out dangerous cardiac features of the presentation.
metrics.coaching_hint: Ask about chest pain, fainting, or symptoms on exertion.

metrics.name: Breathing characterization
metrics.coaching_hint: Characterize the breathlessness: how does it feel, and does anything help?

metrics.name: Reassurance and safety
metrics.coaching_hint: Offer calming reassurance without dismissing the symptoms.

metrics.name: Shared next step
metrics.rationale: Agrees on a concrete next step with the patient.
metrics.coaching_hint: Agree a next step, like slow breathing together or follow-up.
